verses.1: And you have despised the house of Saul, because you brought me forth on account of that which my brother transgressed.
verses.2: And I also made you king, and I will not again appoint a king from his house, because he did not keep my word.
verses.3: And likewise those who do not keep my word and do not walk in my law and in my ordinances, I will withhold from them my wealth and my kingdom from their seed forever.
verses.4: And I swore that I would not again magnify them, except without destroying them; for when I magnified them, they did not magnify me, and when I honored them, they did not honor me.
verses.5: And when I did good to them, they did not do good to me; and when I taught them, they did not teach me.
verses.6: For I set them as head over all, but they did not set me as head over them; and when I honored them above all, they did not honor me, nor did they keep my commandment.
verses.7: And I also have taken away the wealth which I gave them, and I will not restore it to them, as I swore by my life; and whoever honors me, I will honor him, and whoever loves me, I will love him, as says the Lord who rules over all.
verses.8: But those who do not honor me and do not keep my commandment, I will cut them off from my wealth which I gave them.
verses.9: Thus says the Lord who rules over all: whoever loves me, I will love him, and whoever magnifies me, I will magnify him.
verses.10: For I am the Lord who sustains all, and there is none who can deliver from my hand, in heaven above or on earth below; for I am the Lord who kills and gives life, who wounds and heals.
verses.11: And greatness and honor are mine; whoever loves me, I will honor him, and whoever despises me, I will bring low.
verses.12: And I am the one who heals those who love me and remember my name at all times; for the poor and for the rich, I am the provider of nourishment.
verses.13: And not for man alone, but also for the cattle, and for the birds, and for the wild beasts, and for the fish that are in the sea, and for the creeping things.
verses.14: And for the locusts, and for the crawling creatures, and for the worms, and for Behemoth, and for the horned creatures.
verses.15: And all that moves in the water, and all that creeps upon the dust of the earth—all of it is mine.
verses.16: And I am the one who provides with what is fitting and with what is appointed for all those who seek me.
